real_cash.meaning: Held-out observed future cash difference at +20/+52/+100, weighted .28/.52/.20 and divided by 3000. Correlation removes current bank differential from both prediction and observed future.

old_elite.definition: Old fixed elite boards, one archived orientation per frame, only actual Artemis/Apollo actions, same legal inputs, role and shipping-context embedding for both networks. Maps sharing exact initial resource and base hash with any Master training/validation map excluded.
